sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- Chandrajeet Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,J S Audichya
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 16.5.1996 passed by Sri. R.S. Dixit, learned Vth Additional District and Sessions Judge,
Gorakhpur, in Criminal Appeal No. 16 of 1994, confirming conviction of applicant under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, sentencing him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment and to pay fine of Rs. 1000/- and in default thereof, he shall further suffer two months simple imprisonment as awarded vide judgment and order dated 08.03.1994 passed by Sri Chandrahas Ram Saroj, Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offence), Bansgaon, Gorakhpur.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
